verdict.rationale: Attaching documents as a knowledge base for grounded answers is a fair question for an agent framework, but the evidence pack never documents document ingestion, RAG, or grounded answering over user-supplied files. The closest item describes memory features (observational memory, semantic recall, thread-aware storage). That is conversation memory, an adjacent capability, not a knowledge base built from the user's own documents, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, I can attach my own documents and notes as a knowledge base and get grounded answers over them
